subject: fix(paths): stop stranding a legacy database in silence
prompt:
A legacy database can be stranded without a word. `migrateLegacyHome` (packages/shared/src/paths.ts) renames the legacy `alan.db` to `gear.db` only when `gear.db` does not exist yet. Once both files exist, the rename can never happen again, and nothing tells the user: sessions that were written into `alan.db` (for example by an older build that resolved the home differently) are invisible to `/sessions` and one `rm` away from being lost. Today `migrateLegacyHome` returns null in that situation.

What should happen: when both databases exist in the home, `migrateLegacyHome` returns a note that names `alan.db` and says its sessions are `NOT visible` to this build (that wording, with NOT in capitals). It must not delete, rename or merge either file — merging two live databases can interleave colliding ids and different schemas. The existing cases do not change: with only the legacy file present it is still renamed and the note says it was renamed; with no legacy file the result is still null.

Keep the function's signature, and keep the existing tests passing.
f2p: tests/unit/shared/legacy-db-orphan.test.ts :: legacy database left beside the current one > warns when both databases exist, and deletes neither
p2p: tests/unit/shared/legacy-db-orphan.test.ts :: legacy database left beside the current one > says nothing when there is no legacy database
tests/unit/shared/legacy-db-orphan.test.ts :: legacy database left beside the current one > still renames when only the legacy database exists
